Package map for `@livepreso/content-react-ui`. All exports below are available from the main entry unless noted. See llms-full.txt for full usage documentation.

## Entry points

```
@livepreso/content-react-ui          → index.js
@livepreso/content-react-ui/utils    → utils/index.js
@livepreso/content-react-ui/styles.scss → css/base.scss
```

## Utils (`@livepreso/content-react-ui/utils`)

### Data formatting (`utils/data-formatting.js`)

`percentifyFactory`, `currencifyFactory`, `currencyCodifyFactory`, `cleanNumberFactory`, `decimalifyFactory`, `prettyNumberifyFactory`, `posNegFactory`, `undefinedAsDash`, `getPlural`, `isInvalidNumber`, `isUpperCase`, `roundOffDecimal`, `percentToFraction`, `toTwoDecimalsFloat`, `toThreeDecimalsFloat`, `toPercentGrowth`, `capitalise`, `slugify`, `arrayToObjectWithKey`

### Date utilities (`utils/date.js`)

`toDateString`, `getDateRange`, `getDateRangeByDays`, `groupByGranularity`, `getStartOfPeriodsByGranularity`, `getWeekNumberForYear`, `getStartOfWeek`, `getLastYearDate`

### Data processing (`utils/data-processing.js`)

`getFeedDataInRange`, `calculateAverageByMetric`, `processDataToDateDict`, `processYoyDataToDateDict`

### Math utilities (`utils/math-utils.js`)

`findMinMax`, `calculatePercent`, `isValidNumber`

### Table layout (`utils/generate-table-layout.js`)

`getColWidth`
